ValidationRule.description: CJ: Created as part of NZC Phase 2 implementation. Purpose: To restrict the ESG and Data Modeller to edit the annual emission inventory record.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISNEW() ) , (ISPICKVAL( $User.User_Type__c , 'ESG Team') || ISPICKVAL( $User.User_Type__c , 'Data Modeller') ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You Don't Have Permission to Edit This Record
